title: Product Listing Optimization: An Easy Step-by-Step Guide

facts.fact: The guide was last updated on September 19, 2024 and August 14, 2025, per the byline line on the page.
The guide, by author Katrine Villanueva and reviewed by Josh Kohlbach, is structured as a seven-step process for improving product listings for better SEO.
The page defines product listing optimization as refining and enhancing the details of listings so they perform better in search results, especially on WooCommerce or multi-vendor marketplaces.
facts.quote: Product listing optimization** is refining and enhancing the details of your listings so that they perform better in search results

facts.fact: The page lists four SEO application areas for product listings: product titles, SEO-friendly URLs, alt text for images, and meta descriptions.
The page's FAQ section contains five questions.
